findings: The canonical coupling application-accuracy contract contains no built-in numerical groundwater-head acceptance value. h_app is valid only when explicitly available, positive, externally qualified and provenance-bound.
The temporal allocation a_temporal is likewise valid only when explicitly available, externally qualified and provenance-bound.
The groundwater accuracy binding allocates externally qualified head budget into temporal/interface budgets; it does not manufacture an application tolerance from solver or model errors.
No canonical repository authority currently supplies a numeric externally qualified h_app and temporal allocation for the LARE target application.

Current project control records PR #486 as a noncanonical coupling-semantics/application-authority repair in qualification. The production application interpretation of bottom_mode=5 cannot be used as application-level groundwater authority for LARE acceptance.
Therefore C4R/C4T error distributions, Reference numerical floors and shared-host cost data cannot be converted post hoc into ACCEPT_FOR_PURPOSE thresholds.
